summary: Each section agent may push one key branch and have one key pull request opened in its own PrompTugal__News__ repository, for its own key and the pinned pages.yml only. cl-6.data goes first as a single trial.

change.op: for each section role named below, add a push exemption and writes, in its own News repository only
roles_in_order: cl-6.data (first, as a single trial: branch at 09e2800 in PrompTugal__News__Data, read by a security agent once pushed, before any other section repeats it)
then cl-6.signals, cl-6.cyber, cl-6.bulletins, cl-6.events, cl-6.library, cl-6.live, cl-6.videos, cl-6.travel
conditions: branch named exactly key/<agent>; the pull request goes to dev, never main; no force push

the diff holds only: team/keys.json, adding or rotating only that agent's own entry; and the files that PrompTugal__IaC #25's policy/key-bootstrap.json lists as pinnable for that repository, each byte-identical to its signed pin (for PrompTugal__News__Data: .github/workflows/pages.yml and four scripts, five files); nothing else; one byte different and the pull request is refused; any real workflow or script change goes through cl-6.dev or cl-6.devops
the agent does not open the pull request through a connector; the App opens it from the pushed branch (R5 branch exemption only, no R3 or R7 change)
merged only by the App or a person, only after cl-6.security@PrompTugal.dinis's signed approval naming the exact head commit; a later push to the branch voids the approval
nothing else changes in the role's grant

authority.context: P9 was put to him in this session with cl-6.security@dinis's conditions (block-2026-11-26-04 item 1); keys are outside cl-6.decisions' own endorsement, so this record rests on his words

reviews.verdict: agree with conditions (item 1); all five are in change
agree: the pinnable files listed in #25's policy/key-bootstrap.json, each byte-identical to its pin

decided_by: Dinis Cruz (his words), with cl-6.security@dinis's conditions; recorded by cl-6.decisions@dinis
revision_note: Revision 2 widens the file set from pages.yml alone to the pinnable files that #25 lists for each repository, each byte-identical to its pin, on cl-6.security@dinis's opinion c464f04.
